label: Workshop 4
title: AutoResearch
summary: A Hermes agent runs its own training experiments: it edits train.py, trains on a fixed time budget, is graded by a harness it cannot change, and keeps or reverts the change. A light tier runs on a 10 GB GPU; the DGX Spark tier is plan only.
hardware: A 10 GB NVIDIA GPU (light tier) or a DGX Spark; the harness tests run on CPU

prompts.label: Agent never grades itself
prompts.prompt: In the AutoResearch workshop the agent edits train.py but cannot change the harness that grades it. Explain why that separation matters and what could go wrong without it.
